name: suede-design
description: Suede AI design skill for interfaces that feel intentional instead of templated: design tokens, color strategy, OKLCH ramps, type scale, fluid type, visual hierarchy, dark mode, spacing, component laws, motion, full surface builds that ship layout and words together, reference-to-target restyles (Suedify), and source-to-implementation visual QA. Use when asked to design, restyle, polish, or audit a screen, landing page, dashboard, or component; pick colors or fonts; define or fix design tokens;
author: JasonColapietro
